title: Possible continuation of Mohéli merchants’ strike over Bangoma port taxation
notes: The Nov 4 issue describes a few-hour Nov 1 strike as the end of an indefinite strike. The Oct 30 issue reports a gathering on Oct 28 and says activity resumed Oct 29. Shared sector, place and tax dispute make continuity possible, but the pause and event boundary are unresolved. No second November event is created.
open_questions: Was the Nov 1 action a continuation after a temporary pause or a distinct episode?
Was a public gathering of at least 50 simultaneous participants documented on Nov 1?
What is the final end date?
